notes: The vocabulary the USLM statute plugin emits, and nothing more. Deliberately tiny: it covers only what a parser can know for certain from the markup — where a provision sits, what it is headed, and what it points at. It is NOT a model of tax law. Concepts a reader would want (definitions, rates, effective dates, amendments) are interpretation, and belong to whatever extracts meaning rather than structure. Importing and activating this set is a separate, operator-driven step; the plugin never installs it, and core quarantines anything the ACTIVE ontology does not permit regardless of what this file says.
